item.description: ### Fixed - **Messages sent to Devin from your iPhone now arrive.** Devin often missed the Enter that Perch pressed right after pasting the message. The text sat in Devin's input box, unsent, while your phone said it was sent. Perch now waits half a second before pressing Enter. - **Antigravity sessions stay on the list after `agy` updates itself.** When Antigravity updated while a session was running, Perch stopped recognising that session. It dropped off the list, with no replies or Stop from your phone, until you restarted it. Perch now keeps following it, including after the old version's file is cleaned up.
